paper_title: Variations of the lung microbiome and immune response in mechanically ventilated surgical patients
skip_reason: No healthy control group. All three study groups (culture-positive, culture-negative, respiratory tract flora) are mechanically ventilated surgical ICU patients. The culture-negative group is classified clinically as SIRS (not healthy controls) and received BAL due to clinical suspicion of infection. The paper compares clinical subgroups of sick patients, not a disease group against a healthy control.
primary_disease: ventilator-associated pneumonia / pulmonary infection in mechanically ventilated surgical ICU patients
